Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Computer Science AB/BSE at Princeton University

What Princeton University asks of applicants to Computer Science AB/BSE for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

US · All Princeton University courses · Computer Science field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 7 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • Test optional for applicants seeking to enroll in fall 2027 (2026–27 cycle); applying without an ACT or SAT score is not a disadvantage
  • Princeton will require the SAT or ACT again from the 2027–28 cycle (fall 2028 entry)

There are no minimum test score requirements. Princeton’s admissions pages apply to all first-year applicants; students choose a major (A.B. or B.S.E.) once enrolled.

Verified19 Oct 2026Princeton: Standardized Testing · Princeton: First-Year Application Checklist
English language
  • TOEFL, IELTS Academic, Duolingo English Test or PTE Academic required if English is not your native language and your school does not teach in English
  • Not required if English is your native language or you have spent at least three years at a secondary school taught primarily in English

The Princeton pages checked state no minimum English test scores.

Verified19 Oct 2026Princeton: First-Year Application Checklist
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

No course-specific admissions test. The checklist’s required items (application, Princeton-specific Questions, graded written paper, transcript, reports and recommendations) apply to all first-year applicants.

Verified19 Oct 2026Princeton: First-Year Application Checklist
Subject prerequisites
  • Not used in Altiora’s matching yet — see the note for the official guidance

Official: Princeton’s suggested course of study is “not a list of admission requirements”. If possible, it expects four years of English, four years of mathematics (including calculus for students interested in engineering) and at least two years of laboratory science (including physics and chemistry for students interested in engineering), four years of one language and at least two years of history. The calculus and physics/chemistry expectations are stated for students interested in engineering.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Princeton: Before You Apply
A-Level requirements
Grades
Not recorded
Details
Princeton evaluates A-levels in the context of the programme’s curriculum. The academic record should include achieved external-exam marks; where leaving exams are part of graduation requirements, the school should submit predicted or achieved results as they become available.

Princeton states no A-Level grade requirement.

Verified19 Oct 2026Princeton: Before You Apply · Princeton: International Students
IB requirements
Overall score
Not recorded
Details
Princeton evaluates the IB in the context of the programme’s curriculum. The academic record should include achieved external-exam marks; where leaving exams are part of graduation requirements, the school should submit predicted or achieved results as they become available.

Princeton states no IB points requirement. Princeton recommends self-reporting all IB test scores on the application.

Verified19 Oct 2026Princeton: Before You Apply · Princeton: International Students
Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement: Princeton recommends self-reporting all AP (and IB) test scores on the application

Princeton’s advanced placement policy (course placement/credit after enrolling) is not an admission requirement and is not recorded here.

Verified19 Oct 2026Princeton: Standardized Testing
Other requirements
  • Graded written paper required — from an English, social studies or history course in the last three years of secondary school
  • Princeton-specific Questions required
  • Alumni interview:
    • optional, subject to alumni availability
    • opting out is not a disadvantage
  • Arts Supplement: optional
